title: Unit – 2 : Session – 8 : SLO – 2 | Encapsulation
sections: ATM Machine → Sensitive info hidden, accessed securely (PIN/data hidden, accessed through secure operations)
Remote Control → Interface controls what user can operate (buttons = public interface; internals hidden)
Medicine Bottle Cap → Only specific actions are allowed (child-proof cap restricts how it opens, like controlled setters)
Bank Vault → Private data is protected from outsiders (contents inaccessible without authorization)
Mobile Phone Settings → Public method limits how data is accessed (settings app exposes limited, validated options)
